sourcesAudited.product: USD-M Futures exchangeInfo API, official documentation, announcements/changelogs and Binance Data Vision
observedEvidence: The official exchangeInfo documentation defines the current symbol filters and contract fields, but does not expose a historical decision-time query or a complete timestamped filter-change ledger.

The official Binance historical futures order-book download documentation is market-data history, not historical exchangeInfo; its documented depth data has gaps and the snapshot product is limited, so it cannot establish the required metadata history.

Announcements and changelogs provide individual notices, but no evidence was found that they form a complete, lossless, field-level effective-time history for every USD-M perpetual in the frozen window.
whyNotQualified: No official historical exchangeInfo archive or per-symbol effective-time snapshot series was identified.
Current exchangeInfo cannot answer what rules were in force at each historical decisionTime.
Announcement/changelog dates are not a proven complete filter-effective history.

observedEvidence: The API documents listing, active, availableSince/availableTo, priceIncrement, amountIncrement, minTradeAmount, contractType and normalized quote currency metadata.
The documented changes array is accurate and complete only for contractMultiplier; priceIncrement and amountIncrement changes are explicitly best effort and not always complete.

active is current status, and availableTo may be updated after the fact and lag the actual exchange delisting. The documented metadata does not provide a complete historical status/filter record for the frozen decision-time requirement.
minNotional is not documented as a complete historical Binance instrument field in this API.
whyNotQualified: The vendor's own documentation excludes the required completeness guarantee for price and amount increment changes.
The API does not prove complete historical status and minNotional changes at every decisionTime.
A Tardis L2 qualification, if later obtained, would not imply metadata qualification.

sourcesAudited.product: Exchange trading-pair reference data and derivatives contract details
observedEvidence: The derivatives contract endpoint documents base, quote, contract size, listing_timestamp, expiry, strike and underlying index.
The reference-data documentation describes historical derivatives contract information, but does not document a Binance USD-M per-decisionTime history of exchange status or order filters.
No documented fields or completeness guarantee were found for tickSize, stepSize, minQty, minNotional, or timestamped changes to those rules.
whyNotQualified: Contract listing information is not equivalent to a complete point-in-time exchangeInfo rule history.
The required Binance filter fields and their effective timestamps are not documented as available and complete.

observedEvidence: The official reference response documents exchangeEnabled, price and volume limits, precision, contract terms and listingTimestamp; the example may return listingTimestamp null.

The endpoint supports includeInactive and pagination, but the documentation does not provide a versioned per-decisionTime snapshot stream or a complete timestamped change history for Binance USD-M rules.
The documented response does not establish exact tickSize/stepSize/minQty/minNotional history, historical status transitions, or an all-field completeness guarantee.
whyNotQualified: Current/reference instrument metadata is not a historical exchangeInfo event log.
The required field-level effective-time completeness guarantee is absent.

sourcesAudited.product: Public exchange/reference-data candidates beyond the named sources
observedEvidence: No additional public source was identified in the audit that explicitly guarantees all eight frozen fields, complete Binance USD-M historical changes from 2024-01-01 through 2026-07-01, and exact effective timestamps at every decisionTime.
No unverified or marketing-only source is promoted to qualified status.
whyNotQualified: No auditable source contract satisfying the frozen requirement was found.

listingOnboardDate.blocker: No source proves complete per-symbol listing/onboard history and exact validity at every decisionTime.

status.blocker: No source proves complete historical status transitions with effective timestamps.

contractType.blocker: Contract type is available as current/reference metadata, not as a complete PIT change history.

quoteAsset.blocker: Quote asset is documented by several reference APIs, but no source proves a complete PIT history for every symbol.

tickSize.blocker: Tardis explicitly marks non-contractMultiplier increment changes best effort; other sources expose current precision or omit the field.

stepSize.blocker: No audited source provides complete, timestamped Binance USD-M step-size history.

minQty.blocker: No audited source provides complete, timestamped Binance USD-M minimum-quantity history.

minNotional.blocker: No audited source provides complete, timestamped Binance USD-M minimum-notional history.

remainingUnknowns: Complete historical status transitions for every Binance USD-M perpetual and their exact effective timestamps.
Complete tickSize and stepSize changes with native rule values and exact effective timestamps.
Complete minQty and minNotional changes with exact effective timestamps.
A lossless symbol listing/delisting inventory for the whole frozen window, including symbols no longer present in current exchangeInfo.
A source-level completeness guarantee covering all required fields, all symbols and all changes rather than best effort or announcement-derived inference.
Immutable licensed exports, acquisition provenance and hashes for any source that might later be considered for Development.
nextExperimentRule: Any relaxation, substitution or alternative metadata requirement must use a new experiment ID; HY-EXP-0020 remains frozen and closed.
